peers.name: brainstorming
peers.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).

peers.name: systematic-debugging
peers.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

peers.name: writing-plans
peers.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

peers.name: using-superpowers
peers.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

en.tagline: Reports why a superpowers session went wrong, with evidence
en.summary: It reads the transcripts of a superpowers session on disk and reports what happened. Every finding cites a file path and line number. It does not diagnose superpowers or propose changes to it.
problem: A superpowers session can go wrong in ways that are hard to explain: repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that did not fire, or unclear cost and elapsed time.
The skill first pins down with you what went wrong. It then reads the session files and collects evidence, so the answer comes from the transcript and not from memory.
fit: A session repeated work or ignored its plan
A skill did not fire when you expected it to
You want a bug report for the superpowers maintainers
unfit: You want a fix or a proposed change to superpowers
You need a diagnosis of superpowers itself rather than a report of what a session did
steps: Intake: the agent asks one question at a time until it has a problem statement naming the session, what you expected, and what happened.
Locate: it finds the session files on disk, confirms the session, and creates a case folder under ~/.superpowers/diagnosing-superpowers/.
Triage: it reads the region around the problem, then runs one analyst subagent per dimension in parallel and drops any finding without a path:line citation.
Report: it fills a fixed report template with cited evidence, writes it to the workspace, and shows you the path.
Issues: if the report says a superpowers issue is possible or likely, it searches GitHub issues and drafts a new one for your approval.
Export: only when you ask, it builds a scrubbed bundle at the redaction level you choose and archives it only after you approve the scrub log and file list.

zh.tagline: 记录 superpowers 会话出错的原因和证据
zh.summary: 它读取磁盘上 superpowers 会话的记录，并报告实际发生了什么。每条发现都附有文件路径和行号。它不诊断 superpowers 本身，也不提出对它的修改建议。
problem: superpowers 会话可能以难以解释的方式出错，例如重复工作、忽略计划、反复受挫、结果不佳、某个技能没有触发，或者成本和耗时不清楚。
这个技能会先和你确认到底出了什么问题。然后它读取会话文件并收集证据，所以结论基于记录本身，而不是记忆。
fit: 会话重复做了工作，或忽略了它的计划
你期望某个技能触发，但它没有触发
你想为 superpowers 维护者准备一份错误报告
unfit: 你想要修复 superpowers 或对它提出修改建议
你需要的是对 superpowers 本身的诊断，而不是对会话实际行为的报告
steps: 需求确认：代理每次只问一个问题，直到得到一份问题陈述，说明会话、你的预期和实际发生的情况。
定位：它在磁盘上找到会话文件并确认会话，然后在 ~/.superpowers/diagnosing-superpowers/ 下创建案例目录。
分诊：它先阅读问题附近的内容，然后并行启动每个维度一个分析子代理，并丢弃任何没有 path:line 引用的发现。
撰写报告：它按固定模板填写带有引用证据的报告，写入工作区，并告诉你文件路径。
问题检索：如果报告认为可能或很可能是 superpowers 的问题，它会搜索 GitHub 上的 issue，并起草一份新 issue 等你批准。
导出：只有在你要求时，它才会按你选择的脱敏级别构建脱敏包，并且只有在你批准脱敏日志和文件清单后才打包。
